name: Caramel Mokaccino
source: Caramel Mokaccino tells the story of Penelope (Penny), who has returned to the city she lived in when she was a kid to start her superior education. She starts living at the house of some close friends of her family, but soon she feels she should be independent and have her own place, so she looks for a part-time job at a local café called Caramel Mokaccino, owned by one of her childhood friends. While she starts this new chapter of her life, she'll face some problems but she'll have the support of the new people in her life. Follow Penny while she tries to manage her new life, studies, work and also tries to help her newfound friends to solve their own problems.
translation: 《焦糖摩卡奇诺》讲述佩内洛普（佩妮）的故事。她回到儿时生活过的城市，开始接受高等教育。她暂住在家人亲密朋友的家里，却很快意识到自己应该独立生活、拥有自己的住处，于是到当地一家名为焦糖摩卡奇诺的咖啡馆寻找兼职。咖啡馆的老板正是她的一位童年朋友。人生开启新篇章后，她会遇到各种问题，但新结识的人会为她提供支持。跟随佩妮的脚步，看她如何处理新的生活、学业与工作，同时帮助新朋友解决各自的烦恼。
